_about: Micro simulations for scripts/record.py: one short, staged moment of the game per row, recorded hidden at a fixed step.
scene: a scene of unreal/Tools/shots/scenes.json (-AcScene=NAME, which adds that table's defaults and the scene's flags).
flags: the game's own flags, typed before the scene's (the first match wins). The staging flags are documented in their headers:
-AcPilotStage pauses the game after staging: a still. Moving clips use -AcPilot with -AcPilotPath.
-AcPilotDiveAt=S takes over S seconds into the recording, so the clip shows the dive from the RTS view into the unit (-AcPilotDive=S its length, 1.2).
seconds: the clip length; warm: frames rendered before recording (lets TSR, Lumen and exposure settle); width/height/fps: per sim overrides.
sound: record the game's mix offline into the clip (default true); music: let the game's music play (default true; false adds -AcNoMusic).

camera: an RTS camera move, -AcCamPath (AcRtsPawn.h): 'T:DX,DZ,PPC;...' with T in clip seconds, DX,DZ cells from the start view, PPC the zoom (points per cell, 0 = the start zoom; about 10 is far, 40 normal, 130 the closest).

sims.name: ranger-duel
sims.notes: First person: a Ranger duels the enemy Ranger ahead, loses, and the view drops back to the RTS view over the base.

sims.name: ranger-dive
sims.notes: The RTS view over the base, then the dive into a Ranger and a short walk in first person.

sims.name: ranger-third-walk
sims.notes: Third person: a Ranger walks and turns.

sims.name: comet-drive
sims.notes: First person: a Comet drives out and uses its ability.

sims.name: prospector-mining
sims.notes: First person: a Prospector drills Stardust Ore.

sims.name: fight-12
sims.notes: RTS view: two armies of 12 meet.

sims.name: base-night
sims.notes: RTS view: the base at night, beacons blinking.

sims.name: fight-12-dive
sims.notes: RTS view: the camera sweeps in from afar and dives into the fight.

sims.name: base-flyover
sims.notes: RTS view: a slow pan across the base at dusk.

sims.name: longbow-ramp-dive
sims.notes: Day: the top-down view over the player's ramp, the dive into a Longbow on its top, and the drive down it in third person.

sims.name: longbow-siege-first
sims.notes: Day, first person: a Longbow drives up to the enemy base, anchors (the cockpit changes) and shells the buildings.

sims.name: longbow-walk-third
sims.notes: Dusk, third person: an anchored Longbow walks on its legs, firing at the enemy base.

sims.name: longbow-rts-night
sims.notes: Night, top-down: an anchored Longbow left to itself shells the enemy base; the camera pushes in.

sims.name: longbow-packup-first
sims.notes: Night, first person: an anchored Longbow fires, packs up into tank mode, drives in and fires on the move.

sims.name: longbow-finale
sims.notes: Night, third person: a Longbow drives in firing, then the camera pulls out and turns to the gas giant.
